liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): The show opened with Foolish Heart; Transition from Foolish Heart into Jack Straw praised as remarkably smooth [13][18]
- **He's Gone** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer singles out the He's Gone jam as a highlight; He's Gone leads into The Other One, according to this listing [6][18]
- **Hey Pocky Way** (1 review): Vocals drop out after the first verse going into Iko Iko; reviewer wonders if technical or player error [11]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): The jam between Pocky Way and Iko is raw, as much as one could ask from the late 1980s [11]
- **Saint Of Circumstance** (1 review): Band sounds lost and confused rather than funky and aggressive; reviewer calls it the sloppiest part of the night [16]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Reviewer recommends the Wheel intro as a highlight [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-06-18 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-06-18 t02 Foolish Heart**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-06-18 t03 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-06-18 t04 Alabama Getaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-06-18 t05 Queen Jane Approximately**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-06-18 t06 Cold Rain & Snow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-06-18 t07 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **gd89-06-18 t08 Hey Pocky Way**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-06-18.142377.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 185 min [1]
- **gd1989-06-18.164169.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 181 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1989-06-18.dsbd.miller.83709.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 174 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Left and right channels seem flipped on this source; the cassette source sounds better; Less smoothed out than the Walker-Scotton tape but sonically stronger and truer; Phil and Jerry mostly in left channel, Brent right [19][20]
- **gd89-06-18.sbd.wiley.9053.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [6]
- **gd1989-06-18.121369.set1.sonicstudio.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 8 songs; 59 min [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended for the summer solstice, first show of the run; venue had many inside vendors, good space, and no garbage smell [13]
- Large TV screens were used for the first time to let the audience view the band, starting around Jack Straw [13]
- Somewhat sloppy, but the show carries a palpable atmosphere [14]
- Setlist is odd: Pocky Way into Iko, and Alabama Getaway in third slot after a Foolish Heart opener [15]
- Reviewer doubts any Saint of Circumstance after Lost Sailor was dropped was good; this one seems worse than three years earlier [16]
- Reviewer compares this true soundboard with the Walker-Scotton tape, finding it less smoothed but more faithful [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-06-18.142377.schoeps.cmc4.mk2s.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK2S mics spaced on 2 stands, OTS > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info:… [1]. Also: Final 3:08 of U.S. Blues comes from a separate Audio Technica ATM11 audience source supplied by Chuck Miller [1]
- **gd1989-06-18.164169.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 24, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [2]
- **gd1989-06-18.dsbd.miller.83709.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) D [4]
- **gd89-06-18.sbd.wiley.9053.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>??>DAT>CDR [6]. Also: Soundboard source via unknown generation to DAT then CDR; seeded to etree by Tim W [6]
- **gd1989-06-18.121369.set1.sonicstudio.d5scott.flac16**: taped by D5scott; transferred by D5scott; source: Set 1 Source: 2 Sonic Studio DSM-1Sx microphones - 22nd row > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassette; [10]. Also: Source covers only the first set, ending with Hey Pocky Way into Iko Iko, made using Sonic Studio [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Shoreline Amphitheatre, Jun 18, 1989 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/SHO890618.html) [24]
